title.en: Shall, may not, is to be

es: Redactar normas en lenguaje reglamentario con shall, may not, is/are to be y must be / may be + participio, y reconocer su equivalente informal.

teaching.en: Borrowers shall return all loans within three weeks, in accordance with the terms printed on the back of the membership card.
teaching.es: Los usuarios devolverán todos los préstamos en un plazo de tres semanas, de acuerdo con las condiciones impresas en el reverso de la tarjeta de socio.
teaching.explanationEs: Shall en un reglamento = obligación formal («deberán»); no es el shall de ofrecimiento (Shall I help?). In accordance with + norma: conforme a ella.
segments: Borrowers shall return all loans within three weeks, in accordance with
the terms printed on the back of the membership card.
teaching.audioText: Borrowers shall return all loans within three weeks, in accordance with the terms printed on the back of the membership card.

teaching.en: Membership cards may not be lent to another person, and any card found on the premises without its owner will be handed to the desk.
teaching.es: Las tarjetas de socio no podrán prestarse a otra persona, y toda tarjeta hallada en las instalaciones sin su titular se entregará en el mostrador.
teaching.explanationEs: May not + be + participio: prohibición formal en pasiva; no se nombra a quien obedece. On the premises = dentro del local o edificio.
segments: Membership cards may not be lent to another person, and any card found
on the premises without its owner will be handed to the desk.
teaching.audioText: Membership cards may not be lent to another person, and any card found on the premises without its owner will be handed to the desk.

teaching.en: Overdue items are to be returned before the library closes, otherwise borrowers will be liable for a daily fine.
teaching.es: Los artículos con retraso se devolverán antes de que cierre la biblioteca; de lo contrario, los usuarios serán responsables de una multa diaria.
teaching.explanationEs: Is/are to be + participio: orden oficial e impersonal. Be liable for + multa o daño: tener que pagarlo.
segments: Overdue items are to be returned before the library closes,
otherwise borrowers will be liable for a daily fine.
teaching.audioText: Overdue items are to be returned before the library closes, otherwise borrowers will be liable for a daily fine.

teaching.en: Any damaged equipment must be reported to the front desk on the day the damage is noticed, and no attempt should be made to repair it at home.
teaching.es: Todo equipo dañado deberá comunicarse en el mostrador el mismo día en que se detecte el daño, y no se intentará repararlo en casa.
teaching.explanationEs: Must be + participio: obligación en pasiva; lo dañado es el sujeto. Report = comunicar, dar parte de algo.
segments: Any damaged equipment must be reported to the front desk on the day the
damage is noticed, and no attempt should be made to repair it at home.
teaching.audioText: Any damaged equipment must be reported to the front desk on the day the damage is noticed, and no attempt should be made to repair it at home.

teaching.en: Loans may be renewed once, provided that nobody has reserved the book, but renewal is not granted for items that are already overdue.
teaching.es: Los préstamos podrán renovarse una vez, siempre que nadie haya reservado el libro, pero no se concede la renovación de los artículos que ya están con retraso.
teaching.explanationEs: May be + participio: permiso formal en pasiva; provided that añade la condición. Renew = renovar.
segments: Loans may be renewed once, provided that nobody has reserved the book,
but renewal is not granted for items that are already overdue.
teaching.audioText: Loans may be renewed once, provided that nobody has reserved the book, but renewal is not granted for items that are already overdue.

teaching.en: Payment of fines is to be made at the desk within seven days, and borrowers shall not take out new loans while any item is overdue.
teaching.es: El pago de las multas se hará en el mostrador en un plazo de siete días, y los usuarios no podrán sacar nuevos préstamos mientras algún artículo esté con retraso.
teaching.explanationEs: Is to be made: orden oficial impersonal. Shall not + verbo base: prohibición formal («no podrán»). Take out a loan: sacar un préstamo.
segments: Payment of fines is to be made at the desk within seven days,
and borrowers shall not take out new loans while any item is overdue.
teaching.audioText: Payment of fines is to be made at the desk within seven days, and borrowers shall not take out new loans while any item is overdue.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal de la primera norma del cartel.

choices.text: Borrowers will bring back the books in three weeks.
Borrowers can return books within three weeks.
Borrowers shall return books within three weeks.

feedback.es: Shall + verbo base es la fórmula reglamentaria de obligación; will y can no fijan una obligación.

hint.es: Busca el modal que usan los reglamentos para obligar.

origin.text: Informal notice on the library door: You must return books in three weeks. You can't lend your card to anyone. Tell us if a book is damaged.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los préstamos podrán renovarse una vez, salvo que el libro esté reservado.»

feedback.es: May be + participio expresa el permiso formal en pasiva; unless añade la excepción.

hint.es: Es el modal formal de permiso, más reglamentario que can.

origin.text: Loans ___ be renewed once, unless the book has been reserved by another member.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los bolsos se dejarán en la entrada.»

answer.text: Bags are to be left at the entrance

feedback.es: Are to be + participio da una orden oficial sin nombrar a quien la cumple.

hint.es: Are to be + participio: orden impersonal.

prompt.es: Escucha el aviso y elige qué debe hacer quien quiera renovar un préstamo.

choices.text: Make sure nobody else has reserved the book.
Pay a small fine in advance at the desk.
Register again as a borrower at the desk.

feedback.es: La renovación se concede solo una vez y a condición de que nadie haya reservado el libro («provided that nobody has reserved»).

origin.audio: Good morning, and welcome to the library. A few words about how things work here. Borrowers shall return all loans within three weeks, in accordance with the terms printed on your membership card. Overdue items are to be returned at the desk, and borrowers will be liable for a small daily fine. Loans may be renewed once, provided that nobody has reserved the book. Damaged books must be reported to the staff, and no food or drink may be taken into the reading room on any account.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada norma formal con su función.

pairs: Borrowers shall register at the desk.
Food may not be eaten in the reading room.
Overdue items are to be returned at once.

feedback.es: Shall obliga en activa, may not prohíbe, may be permite y are to be da una orden oficial.

pairs: Borrowers shall register at the desk.
Food may not be eaten in the reading room.
Overdue items are to be returned at once.

prompt.es: Lee el aviso: ¿qué tono y propósito tiene?

choices.text: Informal and relaxed: it asks users to show cards if convenient.
Formal and firm: it sets an official rule with a consequence.
Angry: it warns users about heavy fines for any mistake.

feedback.es: Usa shall y anuncia una consecuencia para quien no cumpla: es una norma formal y firme, no una sugerencia.

origin.text: Library notice: from Monday, all users must show their membership card at the desk on request. Borrowers who do not do so shall be asked to leave the premises. This rule is introduced in accordance with the new safety regulations, and it applies to all users without exception.

prompt.es: Escucha a la bibliotecaria y elige qué no puede hacerse con los libros de consulta.

choices.text: Copying a few pages by hand.
Reading them inside the room.
Taking them out of the room.

feedback.es: «May not be taken out of the room» prohíbe sacar los libros de consulta; copiar páginas a mano sí se permite.

origin.audio: A librarian is explaining the rules to a new member. Reference books may not be taken out of the room, she says, although readers may copy a few pages by hand. Loans shall be limited to five items at a time, and overdue items are to be returned before any new loan is granted. If a book is damaged, the borrower should report it at once: nobody will be liable for damage that was reported honestly.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez: ¿qué actitud adopta ella ante quien avisa de un daño?

choices.text: She is kind to users who report damage honestly.
She thinks reported damage should still lead to a fine.
She prefers that users quietly mend small damage themselves.

feedback.es: Dice que nadie será responsable de un daño comunicado con honestidad: es comprensiva con quien avisa.

origin.audio: A librarian is explaining the rules to a new member. Reference books may not be taken out of the room, she says, although readers may copy a few pages by hand. Loans shall be limited to five items at a time, and overdue items are to be returned before any new loan is granted. If a book is damaged, the borrower should report it at once: nobody will be liable for damage that was reported honestly.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los libros dañados deberán comunicarse al personal de inmediato.»

feedback.es: Must be + participio forma la obligación en pasiva; reported es el participio de report.

origin.text: Please do not try to repair anything yourself. Damaged books must be ___ to the staff at once.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Las multas se pagarán en el mostrador antes de las cinco.»

answer.text: Fines are to be paid at the desk before five

feedback.es: Are to be + participio da una orden oficial impersonal; before five fija el plazo.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿qué postura defiende la bibliotecaria sobre el lenguaje formal?

choices.text: That friendly wording is always better.
That formal wording gives rules more weight.
That the current notices already sound official enough.

feedback.es: Defiende que las fórmulas formales suenan a norma oficial y por eso la gente las toma en serio; su colega opina lo contrario.

origin.audio: At a committee meeting, the head librarian proposed changing the wording of the rules. Notices that say you must or you can't, she argued, sound like orders from a teacher, whereas borrowers shall and cards may not be lent sound like official rules, and people take them seriously. Her colleague disagreed: he thought that formal wording makes readers nervous, and he preferred a friendlier tone.

prompt.es: Lee la nota: ¿qué se deduce sobre los cobros por daños?

choices.text: They are charged automatically once a damage form is filled in.
They are the responsibility of the staff member.
They cannot be charged until the manager approves each case.

feedback.es: La nota dice que no se cobrará a nadie hasta que la dirección apruebe cada caso: el cobro depende de esa aprobación.

origin.text: To all staff: with effect from Monday, overdue notices are to be sent by email and not by post. Damaged items shall be recorded on the new form, and no borrower may be asked to pay anything until the manager has approved each case.

prompt.es: Escribe la norma formal sobre la tarjeta de socio.

answer.text: Users shall show their membership card to the staff.
accepted: Users shall show their membership card to the staff.
Users must show their membership card to the staff.
Membership cards are to be shown to the staff.
Membership cards must be shown to the staff.
Users are to show their membership cards to the staff.
Users shall show their membership cards to the staff.
Borrowers shall show their membership card to the staff.
Members shall show their membership cards to the staff.
Users shall show their membership card to staff.

feedback.es: Shall + verbo base (o la pasiva are to be shown) da la obligación formal que exige un reglamento.

origin.text: Escribe en inglés formal: los usuarios deberán mostrar su tarjeta de socio al personal.
